chapter: Union, Emmett Hardy and Rampart Street Parade
title: Hardy's plunger mute, playing with feeling, and Eddie Miller on Rampart Street Parade
summary: He talks of Hardy's use of mute, simple feeling versus force, praises Eddie Miller, and describes the record.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
